trace.pass.none: The model gave no passage for this claim.
trace.pass.failed: The model gave a passage Trace could not find in the PDF, so it is not shown.
trace.never: The manuscript never cites this reference.
trace.path_said: Path to a manuscript or reference list
trace.nothing: A citation with no reference has nothing to judge against.
trace.undo_tip: Undo the last judgement or note, {ref}
trace.unreadable: That file could not be read.
trace.ai.one_no_pdf: AI find passages, once Trace has the PDF
trace.ai.one_tip: Passages in the PDF on each claim of this reference
trace.ai.all: AI find passages for the rows shown
trace.ai.all_tip: Passages in the PDF on each claim, for every reference shown with a PDF and no passages yet
trace.ai.all_had: Every reference shown with a PDF has its passages.

trace.ai.ask_line.one: 1 reference shown with a PDF and no passages yet. Trace asks {model} once.
trace.ai.ask_line.other: {n} references shown with a PDF and no passages yet. Trace asks {model} once for each.

trace.asked_none_left.one: 1 reference asked, {none} with no passage, {left} not asked.
trace.asked_none_left.other: {n} references asked, {none} with no passage, {left} not asked.

trace.keys.head: Shortcuts
trace.keys.move: In the table, the row above or below
trace.keys.open: In the table, open the row
trace.keys.step: On a claim, the one before or after
trace.keys.undo: Undo the last judgement or note
trace.keys.pdf: The PDF, shown or folded away
trace.keys.esc: Close, leave a field, or go back to the table
